'''{{PAGENAME}}''' and '''Wolfgang''' are Synchronists being scolded by Professor '''Mateus'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Mensa''' Ugh... I'm done. Yanked the Rabelle Syncjack out of my back and spent ten minutes puking my guts out.
:;'''Wolfgang''' Same here. Felt like my life got rewound and played back three times over... Cough...

:'''Mensa:''' Ugh... I'm done. Yanked the Rabelle Syncjack out of my back and spent ten minutes puking my guts out.
:'''Wolfgang:''' Same here. Felt like my life got rewound and played back three times over... Cough...
:'''Mensa:''' So… what training level did you crank up to?
:'''Mensa:''' You said not to overdo it, so I only set it to Level 1. And you?
:'''Wolfgang:''' ...Level 3.
:'''Mateus:''' Well, well. Why don't you two just hop straight into the Exostrider, then? Seems like you aren't interested in staying alive.
:'''Mensa:''' Ghhhk—! W-we just… wanted to see if we could break the sync time record…
:'''Wolfgang:''' Hrrk—! And… to get a head start on the training ahead...
:'''Mateus:''' ...Where in the world does Rabelle College recruit idiots like you?
:'''Mateus:''' Listen up. Syncing with the Exostrider isn't about grit, speed, or brute force.
:'''Mateus:''' Look at you now. You can't even keep your heads straight, let alone the pilot stick.
:'''Mensa:''' Sorry... It won't happen again...
:'''Mateus:''' Get yourselves to the infirmary. I've already booked you in with Doctor Luuk. He'll run a proper check.
:'''Mateus:''' I'll be reporting every detail of this incident to the Academy. Next time you want to pull a stunt like this, you'd better check with me first.
:'''Wolfgang:''' A-are you going to help train us, Professor?
:'''Mateus:''' No. I'm worried your brains might short-circuit and fry the whole cockpit system.
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;Ugh… Ever since I forced myself to operate three Mechascouts at once, even a tap on my Syncjack turns my stomach.
:;Seriously? Lemme see

:'''Mensa:''' Ever since I force-piloted three Mechascouts, the second anything touches the Syncjack, I feel sick.
:'''Wolfgang:''' Seriously? I wanna try!
:'''Mensa:''' Are you stupid? If our advisor catches you messing with equipment again, you can forget about graduating.
:'''Mensa:''' I did what I had to. That search team had one Synchronist. Me. Who else was gonna step up?
:'''Wolfgang:''' True. Lucky the crisis is over... But speaking of our advisor, he hasn't been back in days.
:'''Mensa:''' Yeah. Heard the Exostrider leaving shook things up. There are rumors going around that Rabelle College might get shut down.
:'''Wolfgang:''' Huh? Shut down?! How could they do that?!
:'''Mensa:''' Shh, keep your voice down. It's just what I heard. Something about the New Federation redoing the budget...
:'''Wolfgang:''' The budget can go to the void! Is that all they care about?! You can't measure this kind of work with a spreadsheet!
:'''Mensa:''' Eh... Sure, tell 'em about science and ideals. See how far that gets you. Heard the whole Academy is stressed out over it.
:'''Wolfgang:''' B-but... I don't wanna leave! I wanna do research with our advisor for the rest of my life...!
{{Dialogue End}}
